highlights.title: French candidates race to claim the cost-of-living issue ahead of 2027 vote
highlights.summary: A new Ipsos survey reveals a country gripped by pessimism, with soaring prices the top worry for French voters ahead of the April 2027 presidential election. Candidates from far-right leader Marine Le Pen, to the far-left's Jean-Luc Mélenchon are racing to make the cost of living the defining issue ...

highlights.title: SUS imuniza mais de 1 milhão de crianças contra doenças pneumocócicas
highlights.summary: Vacina Pneumo 20 protege contra doenças como meningite e pneumonia, consideradas as causas principais de mortalidade infantil por doença imunoprevenível no mundo

highlights.title: 'Estava prestes a me casar com um violento estuprador em série, mas meus entes queridos salvaram minha vida'
highlights.summary: Amy (nome fictício) contou à BBC que seus amigos e familiares encaminharam à polícia escocesa evidências que foram fundamentais para a prisão do estuprador em série Christopher Malcolm.

highlights.title: Why Middle East tensions are pushing oil prices above $100
highlights.summary: Brent crude has risen above $100 a barrel as war in Iran disrupts shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

highlights.title: Russian Strike on Train Station Near Ukraine-Poland Border Seen as Warning to Kyiv’s Allies
highlights.summary: The attack on Ukraine’s rail network, which connects the country to the West, was a jab at Europe, officials said.

highlights.title: Saudi Leader Meets U.S. Commander as Houthi Attacks Threaten Oil Markets
highlights.summary: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman asked the United States for more U.S. military help last week after the Iranian-backed Houthi forces in Yemen launched a broad offensive.
